files.purpose: Generic CRUD repository BaseRepository[TModel] with soft-delete-aware queries (DS-008). All 6 master repositories inherit this.

functions.name: BaseRepository.__init__
functions.description: Stores session and resolves self.model from the generic TModel via __class_getitem__.

functions.name: BaseRepository.list
functions.description: SELECT all. include_inactive=False (default) filters is_active=True; True returns every row.

functions.name: BaseRepository.get
functions.description: SELECT by PK. Raises NotFoundError if missing.

functions.name: BaseRepository.create
functions.description: Instantiates self.model(**data), session.add, session.flush. Caller commits.

functions.name: BaseRepository.update
functions.description: Loads, applies setattr per key in patch, flushes. NotFoundError if missing.

functions.name: BaseRepository.soft_delete
functions.description: Sets model.is_active = False, flushes. NotFoundError if missing. No row deletion — V1 has no hard-delete (DS-008).

files.purpose: Six entity-specific repositories. Each is a thin subclass of BaseRepository binding TModel and adding entity-specific lookups (e.g. grades by code, design-grade by (design_id, grade_id)).

Adds get_by_pair(design_id, grade_id) → DesignGradeMapModel | None to enforce UNIQUE(design_id, grade_id) on create per AC-016.

files.purpose: Domain-level exception hierarchy. Mapped to HTTP responses by the presentation/api/errors.py handler.

functions.name: DomainError
functions.description: Base class for all domain errors. Stores message; maps to HTTP 500 if no subclass matches.

functions.name: NotFoundError
functions.description: Raised when repository lookup misses. Maps to HTTP 404.

functions.name: ConflictError
functions.description: Raised on UNIQUE violations (e.g. duplicate grade_code, duplicate design-grade pair). Maps to HTTP 409.

functions.name: ValidationError
functions.description: Raised for domain-level rule violations not caught by Pydantic. Maps to HTTP 422.

dependency_graph_notes.summary: Backend forms an acyclic chain: config → infrastructure.db.{base, session, models, repositories} → application.services → presentation.{schemas, dependencies, errors, routers} → main.py. Frontend forms: lib/api/client + types → lib/api/masters + lib/validation → components/admin/{MasterDataTable, MasterFormDialog, per-master Form} → app/admin/<entity>/page.tsx; app/layout depends on lib/query/provider.

open_items_for_sprint_gate: TD-002 (form pattern) is closed by DS-007 in this LLD — verify in sprint-gate.
TD-003 (Next.js CVE-2025-66478) remains open; S1 LLD does not upgrade Next.js. Revisit at S1 sprint-close.
Pagination not added on master list endpoints — V1 master tables are small (≤ ~50 rows each). Document explicitly so /ases-tasks does not over-engineer.
